operators.name: layer_norm_sum

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous (or supports any strides as provided by reference execution, but must be handled correctly)

semantics: Computes LayerNorm over the last dimension (num_features=128) using weight, bias, and eps: y[b, s, f] = ((x[b, s, f] - mean[b, s]) / sqrt(var[b, s] + eps)) * weight[f] + bias[f]
Then sums over dim=1 (sequence length, size 1024): out[b, f] = sum_{s} y[b, s, f]
The reduction over dim=1 is performed in the same kernel to avoid materializing the full LayerNorm output
Input x must be a CUDA float32 tensor with shape [512,1024,128]; weight and bias are CUDA float32 tensors of shape [128]
Output is a new contiguous CUDA float32 tensor of shape [512,128]
No torch operations are used inside the custom op; the computation is implemented in CUDA.
Applies LayerNorm along last dimension with affine parameters weight and bias, eps=1e-5
Computes mean and variance over last dimension (128) per (batch, seq) location
Normalizes and applies affine transformation: y = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * weight + bias
Reduces over dim=1 (sequence length 1024) keeping dims 0 and 2, output shape [512,128]
Returns a single tensor (not a namedtuple or list).
